text:
Monica P.: Hey sales — ACME is asking for our SOC 2 report and wants a clear chain-of-custody for evidence transfer before the POC. They also want the NDA signed and a contact who can attest to redaction. timeline: POC kickoff in 2 weeks.
Rahul S.: Do they want the full report or redacted extracts?
Monica P.: They asked for the full report but are ok with redacted system diagrams. Their infosec insists on documented custody for any raw logs or screenshots.
Katie L.: Legal flagged we should avoid sending raw logs. Can we offer an S3 presigned link with time-limited access + audit log?
Legal Bot: Reminder: standard NDA required before sharing SOC 2 artifacts. If redaction is needed, please run through legal for approved redaction fields.
Rahul S.: Proposed flow: 1) Send NDA 2) Have ACME sign and return 3) We provision a time-limited S3 presigned bucket and a named reviewer with read-only creds and CloudTrail logging 4) Sales Ops coordinate custodian signature. Thoughts?
Sales Ops: I can own step 3 and 4. Need the NDA template and who the custodian is on our side.
Katie L.: Custodian should be an engineering security contact — suggest tagging @rahul.s for that. Legal: which NDA variant should we use? standard-sales-nda-v3?
Legal Bot: Use standard-sales-nda-v3 for new enterprise prospects. If they request bridge/ack letter for SOC2 interim access, route to Legal Privileged for quick sign.
Monica P.: ACME asked about a "bridge" or interim assurance note instead of full report — they want something quicker to unblock procurement. Can Legal prepare an interim statement confirming SOC 2 scope and that full report will be shared under NDA?
Legal Bot: Interim assurance statements are possible but need timeline and signatory. Please provide: (a) business unit owner, (b) requested scope, (c) expected delivery date of full report.
Rahul S.: I'll be the engineering custodian. Scope: inference runtime + control plane only. Delivery date for full report: 2 weeks from NDA execution (we actually have the report ready but need approvals).
Sales Ops: I'll send NDA draft to ACME today and include the presigned access plan. Monica, want me to cc Legal?
Monica P.: Yes please cc Legal and include Katie. Add note that redaction will remove IP-sensitive diagrams and that access will be time-limited and audited.
Katie L.: Quick note on redaction: we usually redact internal hostnames and customer PII. Legal, confirm that's acceptable.
Legal Bot: Confirmed — redact hostnames and customer data. Log of what was redacted must be retained.
Rahul S.: One more ops note: will attach a one-line command that ACME can run to verify object integrity: `sha256sum report.pdf` — we can share the checksum in a separate signed email after NDA.
Monica P.: Great. I'll update the ACME thread and share next steps. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Sales Ops: Filed action items: NDA out, presigned bucket ready once NDA returns, custodian access granted to Rahul, redaction checklist to Legal. Will update channel when sent.
Monica P.: Closing loop — please ping here when NDA is signed so I can schedule the POC kickoff.
